articles.summary: BEVERLY, Mass., March 18, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) -- ATN International, Inc. (Nasdaq: ATNI) announced that its Board of Directors has declared a quarterly dividend of $0.275 per share, payable on April 10, 2026, on all common shares outstanding to stockholders of record as of March 31, 2026.
articles.title: ATN Board Declares Quarterly Dividend
